title: Exotic Sweet Filipino Digestive Biscuits Grill
description: A unique Filipino dish featuring digestive biscuits grilled to perfection with a sweet and gooey twist, served as a dessert.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, brown sugar, sweetened condensed milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Submerge each digestive biscuit into the mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Place the coated biscuits on the preheated grill and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
While the biscuits are cooking, sprinkle sesame seeds on top of each biscuit.
Once the biscuits are cooked, brush the yakimono grill sauce on top of each biscuit.
Serve the grilled biscuits warm, garnished with additional sesame seeds if desired.
Let the biscuits cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the filling to set.
